provider_receipt.summary: Review found four named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:184-192 permits wikilinks containing ../ to resolve outside the private vault and exposes those external paths when they exist; (2) src/lib.rs:56-89 MemoryStore::store only serializes and discards each MemoryRecord, so scan_vault provides no persistent Mnemosyne ingestion despite its stated interface; (3) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently drops WalkDir traversal and permission errors, allowing incomplete scans to report success; (4) src/lib.rs:13-25 requires the legacy numeric-confidence frontmatter shape and cannot ingest documents conforming to docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-94, which specifies string confidence and additional required classification/privacy fields. Durable verification supports only a clean tree; it provides no behavioral or security evidence addressing these defects. No project files were modified.
